rationale: The StopSign accounts record the observations and the questioned interpretation, but the acceptance arithmetic that makes the failure permanent is only stated inside an interpretation. This update promotes it to a durable behavior entry: log_sync carries the StopSign separately from the suffix, sync_log adds one for it on top of sync_idx plus suffix length, and when sync_idx already covers the StopSign the follower's accepted index ends one past its last log position so decided can never equal it. Sources and the executed receipt are cited.

knowledge.statement: create_log_sync sends the StopSign in a separate log_sync field and starts the suffix at the follower's valid entries index, then sync_log sets accepted_idx to sync_idx + suffix length and adds one more when log_sync carries a StopSign. When sync_idx already covers the StopSign (the follower's accepted prefix includes it), accepted_idx becomes one greater than the follower's last log position. Since nothing may be appended after an accepted StopSign, decided can reach at most that last position and stopsign_is_decided (decided == accepted) can never become true for that follower. When sync_idx precedes the StopSign, the same +1 is correct and the follower ends consistent.
knowledge.conditions: SequencePaxos follower applying an AcceptSync whose log_sync carries a StopSign; the follower either already accepted that StopSign (sync_idx includes it; defect) or had not (sync_idx precedes it; correct). No snapshots involved.
